Diamond & Pearl series · MD

Majestic Dawn

Released May 1, 2008 · 100 cards

Majestic Dawn is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Diamond & Pearl series, released in English on May 1, 2008. It has 100 cards. It includes 82 Pokémon, 13 Trainer and 5 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

17 illustrators worked on Majestic Dawn. Most cards: Daisuke Ito (13), Ryo Ueda (13), Kent Kanetsuna (12), Masakazu Fukuda (11), Ken Sugimori (9), Kouki Saitou (8), Kagemaru Himeno (6), Takumi Akabane (5).
